text_en: Scout 3 path cards, then draw 1 path card.
text_zh: 侦察 3 张路径牌，然后抓 1 张路径牌。

text_en: Choose up to 4 total moments or attributes from any number of Ranger discards. Place the chosen cards facedown on the top of their Ranger’s fatigue stack.
Choose up to 4 total moments or attributes not named Paths We've Roamed Before from any number of Ranger discards. Place the chosen cards facedown on the top of their Ranger’s fatigue stack.
You can only commit this attribute when interacting with a trail.
Exhaust (use 1 morsel): Choose a Ranger. That Ranger soothes fatigue equal to the number of [FIT] in their energy pool.
When you play this gear, attach a moment to it from your hand. Exhaust (use 1 echo): Play the attached moment as if it were in your hand. It remains attached to this gear instead of being discarded.

Play a moment from your discard pile without paying its energy cost (X is equal to the chosen moment’s cost).
This card can be played at the time specified on the chosen moment.
Exhaust (use 1 charge): Spend 1 energy to gain 1 energy of any type.
Unique. Response: After you play a moment, soothe 1 fatigue.
[FOC] + [connection] (use 1 session): Meditate on your journey to shuffle a number of cards from your fatigue stack into your Ranger deck equal to your effort.
[FOC] + [connection] (use 1 session): Meditate on your journey to shuffle a number of cards from your fatigue stack into your Ranger deck equal to your effort.
Choose a ranger. That ranger may discard one of their equipped gear to search their ranger deck for a gear and equip it without paying its energy cost.
Reduce the equip value of your gear by 1 (to a minimum of 1). [AWA] + [reason] use 1 pocket: Open your belt pouch and reach inside to search your Ranger deck for a gear and add it to your hand.
Attach to a Ranger’s equipped tech. When you play this attachment, add 3 tokens to the attached gear. Response: When this card becomes unattached, discard 3 tokens from the attached gear.
Exhaust (use 1 charge): Choose a Ranger’s equipped gear. Resolve the chosen gear’s effect as if you had used a token from it and/or exhausted it.
Exhaust (use 1 charge): Choose a Ranger’s equipped tech. Resolve the chosen tech’s effect as if you had used a token from it and/or exhausted it.
Choose an attachment in a Ranger’s discard. That Ranger may immediately play that attachment as if it were in their hand.
Discard one of your equipped gear to add [harm] to a being equal to the number of tokens on the discarded gear.
Attach to a Ranger’s equipped gear. Response: When a Ranger performs a test from the attached gear, commit 1 effort.
Attach to one of your equipped gear. Response: After you use a token from the attached gear, soothe 1 fatigue.
Use X buffers: When you perform a test, suffer X fewer fatigue from each card between you and the card with which you are interacting.
Response: When you rest, exhaust up to one being for each [AWA] in your energy pool.

Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Exhaust: Add 1[harm] to a being in the same area as this companion. [AWA] + [reason]: Survey the way ahead to scout path cards equal to your effort, then draw 1 path card.
Each Ranger may discard 1[progress] from a being within reach of them to move that being.
One at a time, Each Ranger may move a being within reach of them. Add 1[progress] to each being moved in this way.
Move all [progress] from a being to a feature.
Exhaust (use 1 call): When a Ranger would suffer an injury from a predator or [harm] would be added to a being by a predator, cancel that effect.
Choose a being. Move [progress] from the chosen being to each other card in play, up to 1[progress] per card.
Choose one: Discard 1[harm] from a being to add 3[progress] to it. Heal 1 injury from a Ranger.
Attach to a predator. Attached card loses the predator trait. Response: Before a challenge effect on the attached card would resolve, you may discard 2[progress] from it to cancel the effect.
Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Exhaust: Move a being and add 2[progress] to it. [FIT] + [connection]: Pet your canine companion to ready this being and soothe 1 fatigue.
Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Exhaust: Move a being and add 1[progress] to it. [FIT] + [connection]: Pet your canine companion to ready this being and soothe 1 fatigue.

Search the path deck and discard for a flora and put it into play with this skill attached.
Increase the attached flora’s [harm] threshold by 2.
Response: When a Ranger performs a test, they may add 1[harm] to a flora to dodge each being in the same area as that flora.
Attach to any Ranger’s equipped gear. Response: When you add [harm] to a being with the attached gear, exhaust that being and attach this card to it. The attached being gains the flora trait.
Add 1 [harm] to a flora to add 3 [progress] to a trail.

[SPI] + [reason]: Tend to the local plants to add or remove [harm] from a flora equal to your effort. [FIT] + [conflict]: Strike [2] out with your gardening tool to add 1[harm] to a being for every 2 effort. If you fail, suffer 1 injury.

Attach to a feature.
Attached feature gains the flora trait.
Response: After you add 1 or more [harm] to a flora, you may add 1 herb to this gear. Exhaust (use 1 herb): Choose a Ranger. That Ranger gains 1 energy of any type.
Each Ranger may add 1 [harm] to a flora to soothe 1 fatigue and gain 1 energy of any type. When you add [harm] to a flora in this way, you may not exceed its [harm] threshold.
Response: After you add 1 or more [harm] to a flora, you may add 1 vittle to this gear. Exhaust (use 1 vittle): Choose a Ranger. That Ranger soothes 2 fatigue.
Exhaust: When you perform a test, dodge 1 card.
Exhaust: Move your [ranger] to a feature. That feature fatigues you.
Response: When you Traverse, dodge up to 3 cards.
[AWA] + [reason] (use 1 drop): Clarify your view of the environment around you to scout path cards equal to your effort, then draw 1 path card.
Exhaust each obstacle. Suffer fatigue equal to the number of obstacles exhausted this way.
Exhaust each obstacle.
Exhaust (use 1 sensor): When a Ranger performs a Traverse test, commit 1 effort.
Exhaust (use 1 stride): Add 1[progress] to a trail. [FIT] + [conflict]: Strike [2] out with your walking implement to add 1[harm] to a being for every 2 effort. If you fail, suffer 1 injury.
Discard any number of [progress] from a trail to add an equal number of [harm] to a being.
Discard any number of [progress] from a trail to add an equal number of [harm] to a being.
Exhaust: When a Ranger scouts, increase the number of cards scouted by 1.
Response: When you rest, add entries equal to the number of [FOC] in your energy pool. Use 1 entry: When a Ranger interacts with a feature, commit 1 effort.

Response: When you travel, if this trail is attached to the location, travel to a location up to two paths away. Use the terrain of the second path when building the path deck. Clear [progress]: Attach this trail to the location.
Response: After you succeed at a Traverse test, add [progress] to a being equal to your effort. This is in addition to the test’s standard effect.
Response: When you perform a test, discard any number of cards from your fatigue stack to commit 1 effort to that test for every 2 cards discarded this way.
Choose a trail. Soothe fatigue equal to the number of [progress] on that trail. This fatigue may be divided as you choose between all Rangers.
Exhaust: Ready a tech.
Exhaust: Spend 1 energy to add 1 token to a tech.
Exhaust (use 1 profile): When a Ranger performs an Avoid test, commit 1 effort.
Attach to a predator. Use 1 length: When the attached predator would ready, it remains exhausted. [FIT] + [conflict]: Lead the animal to move the attached predator.
Discard this gear from play to exhaust beings equal to the number of charges on this gear. Response: After you succeed at an Avoid test, add 1 charge to this gear.
Attach to a location or feature. The attached card gains the trail trait. Response: When 1 or more [progress] is added to the attached trail, increase the number of [progress] added by 1.

During your turn, you may treat obstacles as if they did not have the obstacle keyword. [FIT] + [reason] (use 1 charge): Climb the obstructing terrain with the agility of a spider to move your [ranger] to an obstacle.
[FOC] + [conflict] (use 1 dart): Shoot one of the featherlight darts to add [harm] to a being equal to your effort. Whether you succeed or fail, dodge all cards between you and that being.
When you play this gear, choose an aspect (you may place a spare energy token here as a reminder). Exhaust (use 1 sip): Gain 1 energy matching the chosen aspect.
Response: After a path card is cleared, add 1 inkrill to this gear. Use 1 inkrill: When a Ranger interacts with a feature, commit 1 effort.
Exhaust (use 1 charge): When you perform a Traverse test, use [FOC] instead of [FIT].
Response: After you succeed at an Avoid test, exhaust 1 additional being
Use 1 charge: When you would suffer 1 or more fatigue from a path card, reduce the fatigue suffered to 0.
Reponse: When a Ranger would suffer 1 or more fatigue, they soothe that amount of fatigue instead.
Exhaust: Reduce a being’s presence to 0 until the end of the turn.
Exhaust: Reduce a being’s presence by 2 until the end of your turn.
Exhaust: Spend 1 energy to add 1 token to an aid card.

Attach to a feature.
Reduce the attached feature’s presence by 1 for each marker on this attachment.

Attach to a being.
Reduce the attached being’s presence by 1 for each snare on this attachment.
Reduce the presence of each card in play to 0 until the end of the next turn.
Reduce the presence of each card in play to 0 until the end of the next turn.
Response: After you succeed at a Connect test, add [progress] to a feature equal to your effort. This is in addition to the test’s standard effect.

[FIT] + [conflict] (use 1 pulse): Strike [2] with a pulse of kinetic energy to add 1[harm] to a being and exhaust it. If you fail, discard 1[progress] from that being; if you cannot, it fatigues you instead.
Attach to a being. Response: After a challenge effect on the attached being resolves, add 1 track. Use 1 track: When a Ranger performs a test, commit 1 effort.
Exhaust (use 1 charge): When a Ranger performs a Connect test, commit 1 effort.
Response: When a Ranger would suffer an injury or [harm] would be added to a being, cancel that effect. Suffer 1 injury.
Response: When a Ranger would suffer an injury or [harm] would be added to a being, cancel that effect.
Attach to a being. Use 1 alarm: When a challenge effect on the attached being would resolve, cancel that effect.
Attach to the location. Use 1 alarm: Before a challenge effect on a being would resolve, cancel that effect.
Exhaust a being. Then add [progress] to that being equal to the number of exhausted beings within reach.
Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Exhaust: Discard 1[progress] from this being to add 1 token to an aid card and 2[progress] to another being.
Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Exhaust: Discard 1[progress] from this being to add 1 token to an aid card or 2[progress] to another being.

Search the path deck and discard for a human and put them into play with this card attached. Response: When the attached human is cleared, move the [progress] from it to any number of other beings, divided as you choose
Exhaust: Scout 1 challenge card.
Exhaust: Choose a manifestation in your discard, and add it to your hand.
Exhaust: Discard a card from your hand to choose a manifestation in your discard and add it to your hand.

Manifestation. Attach to a feature, and add 2[progress] to it. Response: When a Ranger performs a test, they may discard 1 or more [progress] from the attached feature to dodge an equal number of cards in the same area.

Manifestation. (To play a manifestation, discard 1 token from a conduit.) [AWA] + [conflict]: Strike with a whirling coil of wind and water to add [harm] to a being equal to your effort. Then exhaust that being.
Conduit. Setup. Response: After the challenge deck is shuffled, add 1 glint to this conduit. Exhaust (use X glints): Scout X path cards.

Manifestation. Response: When drawing challenge cards during a test, draw and discard challenge cards until you draw one with a +1 in the used aspect. Use that challenge card for this test, and suffer fatigue equal the number of cards discarded this way.

Manifestation. Response: When drawing challenge cards during a test, draw and discard challenge cards one at a time until you choose to stop. Use the last challenge card drawn for this test, and suffer fatigue equal to the number of cards discarded this way.

Manifestation. <f>(To play a manifestation, discard 1 token from a conduit.)</f>
Add 1[progress] to each feature and location. Then you may redistribute any number of [progress] between them.
Conduit. Setup. Response: After you succeed at a Traverse test, add 1 stride to this conduit. Exhaust (use X strides): Add X[progress] to a trail.

Manifestation. (To play a manifestation, discard 1 token from a conduit.) Response: When a Ranger reveals a challenge card during a test, choose which modifier to use from that card. Then choose an additional challenge icon to resolve for this test.
Response: After you perform a test in which you committed 1 or more manifestation, gain 1 [FOC]. Response: When you rest, if you have 1 or more [FOC] in your energy pool, scout 1 challenge card.
Conduit. Setup. Response: Before you draw a challenge card, name a challenge icon; if that icon is on the drawn card, add 1 vision to this conduit. Exhaust (use X visions): Scout X Ranger cards.
Manifestation. Attach to a being within reach of any Ranger. Response: After a challenge effect on the attached being resolves, the Ranger that played this card gains 1 energy of any type.

Manifestation. <f>(To play a manifestation, discard 1 token from a conduit.)</f>
Choose a being in play, and shuffle it into the path deck. Then search the path deck and discard for a being and put it into play.
Conduit. Setup. Response: After you perform a test in which no challenge effects were resolved, add 1 song to this conduit. Exhaust (use X songs): Add X[progress] to a being.
After you succeed at a test in which you committed this attribute, you may suffer 1 fatigue to add it back into your hand.

After you succeed at a test in which you committed this attribute, you may suffer 1 fatigue to add it back into your hand.

After you succeed at a test in which you committed this attribute, you may suffer 1 fatigue to add it back into your hand.

Exhaust: When you would suffer 1 or more fatigue from a path card, reduce the amount of fatigue suffered to 0.

[FOC] + [exploration]: Navigate the winding tunnel to move your [ranger] to this feature. Response: When you perform a test, if your [ranger] is on this feature, add 1[harm] to it to dodge each card in the same area. Clear [harm]: If your [ranger]is on this feature, suffer 1 injury.
Search the path deck for a card and place it on top or bottom of the deck.
Exhaust (use X sketches): Exhaust a path card with presence X. [AWA] + [reason]: Sketch [X] your subject to choose a path card and add X sketches to this book. X is equal to that card's presence.

Manifestation.
Choose any number of path cards within reach and shuffle them into the path deck, then draw 1 path card.
Exhaust (use 1 form): Exhaust and move a being.
Attach to a path card. Reduce the attached card's presence by 2. Response: When the attached card fatigues a Ranger, add 1[harm] to it.
[AWA] + [reason] (use 1 graph): Calibrate the device to your current environment to scout 2 path cards for every effort.
Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Exhaust: Add 3[harm] to a being and [harm] to Quiet equal to that being's presence.

[FIT] + [conflict] (use 1 rake): Slash [X] with Umbra's claw to add [harm] to a being equal to your effort. If you fail, suffer 1 injury. X is equal to the being's presence. Do not resolve [crest] effects during this test.

Exhaust (use 1 vault): Exhaust an obstacle. Response: When there are no vaults on this gear, discard it. [AWA] + [conflict]: Fish [2] if there is a water card in play to soothe 2 fatigue and add 2[progress] to a water card.
[FIT] + [conflict] (use 1 fiber): Slice [X] with the fibrous blade to add [harm] to a being equal to your effort. If you fail, suffer 1 injury. X is equal to the being's presence.

Setup. You may travel on river paths. While your [ranger] is on this vehicle, treat the presence of all water features as 1 lower and the presence of all non-water features as 1 higher. [FIT] + [reason]: Board the boat to move your [ranger] to this vehicle or return it to your role.
If you have a weapon equipped, add 5 [harm] to a being. Then suffer fatigue equal to the number of [harm] on that being in excess of its harm threshold.

Manifestation. <f>(To play a manifestation, discard 1 token from a conduit.)</f>
Add 1 [harm] to a flora to add 4 [harm] or 4[progress] to a path card. If that path card is a biomeld, increase the number of [harm] or [progress] added to it by 2.
Add 3[progress] to a trail. If it's a mountain or obstacle, increase the number of [progress] added by 2.
You may move each being. Then resolve a challenge effect on a being of your choice. Resolve this effect even if the being is exhausted.
Use 1 needles: When a Ranger reveals a challenge card during a test, choose a modifier from that card. Spend 1 energy matching that modifier's aspect to use it for this test instead.
Exhaust (use 1 shift): When you perform a test, dodge each card in play. If you fail that test, suffer 1 injury.
Scout 1 path card,1 challenge card, and 1 Ranger card from each Ranger's deck.
Response: When a Ranger performs a test, commit X effort.
Attach to a feature. Response: After the attached feature is cleared, scout X path cards. X is equal to the number of beings in play.
Use 1 pulse: When you rest, scout 3 Ranger cards.
Search your Ranger deck for any number of cards and place them facedown on top of your fatigue stack in the order of your choice.
Add 5[progress] to a being. Then, if the being hasn't cleared, resolve each of its challenge effects in an order of your choice. Resolve these effects even if the being is exhausted.
Add 1[harm] to each flora. Add X[progress] to each being. Then each ranger soothes X fatigue. X is equal to the total number of [harm] added by this card.
Add 1[harm] to up to 5 flora. Add X[progress] to each being. Then each ranger soothes X fatigue. X is equal to the total number of [harm] added by this card.
Exhaust (use 1 dollop): Choose a Ranger. That Ranger soothes fatigue equal to the number of [FOC] in their energy pool.
Exhaust (use 1 bite): Choose a Ranger. That Ranger soothes fatigue equal to the number of [SPI] in their energy pool.
Exhaust: When a Ranger performs a Connect test that interacts with a human, commit 2 effort.
Each Ranger soothes all fatigue.
Attach to your role. Exhaust (use 1 xp): Ready your role.
Fatiguing 2 Response: When you draw this card, attach it to your role. [FIT] + [reason]: Treat [2] and bandage the injury to return this card to your collection.
Exhaust (use 1 flash): Choose a path card. That card gains illumination until the end of the turn. [FOC] + [reason] (use 1 flash): Distract with a brilliant flash of light to exhaust a being.

Exhaust: When you would suffer 1 or more fatigue, draw a challenge card and resolve the following effect based on its icon: [sun] Soothe that amount of fatigue instead. [mountain] Prevent that fatigue. [crest] Suffer 1 additional fatigue or discard this gear.
Choose one: Exhaust X path cards. Shuffle a path card with X or less presence into the path deck. Then search the General set for a Fractal Frog and shuffle it into the path deck.

Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Exhaust: Shuffle a being attached to this biomeld into the path deck. If that being was a predator, add 3[harm] to another being. If it was a prey, add 4[progress] to another being. Otherwise, exhaust another being. If there is not a being attached to this biomeld, it gains the following test: [AWA] + [connection]: Suggest a new form to attach a non-human being from the path discard facedown to this biomeld. Then exhaust this biomeld.

Manifestation. <f>(To play a manifestation, discard 1 token from a conduit.)</f>
Add 1[harm] to a flora to place a path card on top of the path deck. If that card is a biomeld, place it on the bottom of the path deck instead.

Attach to a Ranger's equipped gear. Response: After a Ranger succeeds at a test from the attached gear, if it cleared a being, scout 1 path card. If it cleared a feature, add 2[progress] to the location. Otherwise, scout 1 Ranger card.
If you have a weapon equipped, add 3[harm] to a being. It fatigues you. If it fatigues you for 2 or more, add 2 additional [harm].
Setup. Exhaust (use 1 filter): When you interact with a water card, commit 2 effort. This gear cannot be discarded or returned to your hand by path card effects.

Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Exhaust: Look at the top card of the path deck. Add [progress] equal to its presence to another path card in play that shares its card type. [FIT] + [connection]: Nuzzle your little friend to ready this being and soothe 1 fatigue.
Attach to a feature. Exhaust: The attached feature gains illumination until the end of the turn. Then, if it's a machine, add 1 unique token to it.

Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Spirit. [FOC] + [exploration]: Navigate [2] alongside the spirit to add [progress] to this being equal to your effort. Then you may move your [ranger] to a feature in the same area.

[FOC] + [exploration] (use 1 entry): Consult observations on the arcology to add 1[progress] to a feature for every 2 effort. If that feature is a ruin or machine, add [progress] equal to your effort instead. Then, read [guide] 197.
Move a feature. It fatigues you. Then add [progress] to that feature equal to your fatigue.
Unique. Exhaust: When you suffer 1 or more fatigue, add an equal number of [progress] to the location. Response: If you have 1 or less fatigue, discard this gear.
Each Ranger can move their [ranger] to a being, feature, or the location.
Setup. Exhaust (use 1 cell): When you interact with a machine, commit 2 effort. [FOC] + [reason] (use 1 cell): Interface with a device to add 1 unique token to a machine for every 2 effort.

Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Exhaust: Discard 3[progress] from this being to resolve a challenge effect on a being. [AWA] + [exploration]: Chase [2] the scampering lutrinal to add 1[progress] to a feature for every 2 effort. Then add an equal amount of [progress] to this being and move it.
Manifestation. Attach to a feature or location. When you Traverse the attached card, dodge all obstacles. If you fail, prevent the injury and return this manifestation to your hand.
Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Spirit. [SPI] + [reason]: Reflect [2] on the spirit's wisdom to add [progress] to this being equal to your effort. Then scout 1 challenge card.

Response: Before you decide to travel, if there is 2[per_ranger] or more [progress] on the location, you may travel (regardless of the location's [progress] threshold). If there is 5[per_ranger] or more [progress] on it, travel to a location up to two paths away. Use the terrain of the second path when building the path deck.
While this card has at least 1 gleam remaining, within reach is illuminated. Exhaust (use 1 gleam): When you perform a test, dodge each card within reach.
Attach to a path card. Exhaust: When a Ranger performs a test that interacts with the attached card, commit 2 effort. This test can be performed without commiting energy.
Setup. Exhaust (use 1 puff): When you interact with a flora, commit 2 effort. [FOC] + [reason] (use 1 puff): Release a cloud of spores to exhaust a flora.

Manifestation.
Choose a flora and either remove 1[harm] from it or add 2[progress] to it. Then add 4[progress] to a non-biomeld being in the same area as the chosen flora.

Deployed: When you add 1 or more [progress] to a being, increase the [progress] added by 1. When you add 1 or more [progress] to a feature, decrease the [progress] added by 1. This gear gains the following ability: Response: When you rest, soothe 2 fatigue.

You can Connect with flora features. Exhaust: After you successfully Connect with a flora, soothe 1 fatigue. If that flora has the mycelial keyword, add [progress] equal to your effort to each other flora with the mycelial keyword.

Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Spirit. [FIT] + [connection]: Tend [2] to the land alongside the spirit to add [progress] to this being equal to your effort. You may discard 1[harm] from a feature. If it is a flora, soothe 2 fatigue.
Choose a Ranger to soothe all of their fatigue. Then that Ranger places an equal number of cards from their hand facedown on top of their fatigue stack in any order.
Exhaust (use 1 tune): After you play a moment or attachment, soothe 1 fatigue. If that card is a tale, gain 1 energy matching that card's aspect.

After you commit this attribute, search your Ranger deck for the next attribute that you can commit to this test and commit it. If this test is successful, place that attribute on top of your fatigue stack.

Unique. Objective (6 hunches: [aspiration]). This gear does not ready during the refresh phase. Exhaust: When a feature with 2 or more presence is cleared, add 1 hunch to this gear and 1[progress] to the location. Response: When you travel, ready this gear.
Exhaust (use 1 insight): Before you play a moment, reduce its cost by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

Response: After a path card is cleared by [progress], choose a Ranger. That Ranger names a trait. Then they search their Ranger deck and discard for the next moment with the chosen trait and add it to their hand.

Objective (6 improvements: [aspiration]). Attach to a human. Response: When a Ranger Connects with the attached human, the Ranger who played this card may discard 1 token from on of their equipped gear to commit 1 effort. Response: After the attached human is cleared with [progress], record 1 improvement and discard this attachment.
Attach to one of your equipped tech. Exhaust: After you succeed at a Traverse test, add 1 token to the attached tech.

Response: When one of your equipped gear is discarded, you may attach it to this gear, facedown. Exhaust: When a Ranger performs a test, commit a card attached to this gear. (Discard the committed card after the test is resolved.)

Attach to a Ranger's equipped gear.
Reduce the equip value of the attached gear by 2 (to a minimum of 0).
Search your Ranger deck for a being and add it to your hand. You may discard another being from your hand to play the being you searched for without paying its energy cost.

Exhaust (use 1 essay): Move a being. Use 1 essay: When a being would move, it does not. [SPI] + [exploration]: Deepen [2] your understanding to add 1[progress] to a being for every 2 effort. Then add 1 essay to this book.

Objective (7 records: [aspiration]). Exhaust: Choose a being in the path discard with the same name as a being in play. If no attached beings have that name, attach the being from the path discard to this gear facedown. If you do, add 1 record to this gear and 2[progress] to the being in play.

Attach to a being within reach. Response: After you successfully Connect with the attached being, soothe 1 fatigue. Response: When [harm] would be added to the attached being, discard this attachment to prevent that [harm].
Scout X path cards. X is equal to twice the number of flora in play. If there are no flora in play, search the path deck for the next flora and put it into play.
Attach to a flora. Response: When the attached flora clears by [harm], add [harm] to a being in the same area equal to the amount of [harm] on that flora.
[FOC] + [reason] (use 1 lesson): Absorb the botanical knowledge to choose a nature card in your Ranger discard and place it on top of your fatigue stack.
Objective (6 seeds: [aspiration]). [SPI] + [reason]: Plant [5] a brightfruit seed to add 1[progress] to a feature and record 1 seed. Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 for each flora in play.
Exhaust: Scout 1 path card.
Response: When you would draw a path card, instead discard the top card of the path deck. Then, suffer fatigue equal to that card's presence.

Friendly. Persistent. Unique. Exhaust: Discard 1[progress] from an obstacle to move your [ranger] to it. [AWA] + [exploration]: Scavenge [2] for useful scrap to add 1 token to a tech. If you fail, draw a path card.

Exhaust: When you suffer 1 or more fatigue, add an equal number of stories to this book. [SPI] + [exploration]: Reflect [2] on your travels to discard all stories from this book. If you discarded at least 4 stories, shuffle up to 2 cards from your fatigue stack into your deck.
Use 1 slice: After a being enters play, if it's the start of the round, add 1[progress] to that being. If it enters play during a Ranger's turn, add 2◭ to that being instead.
Exhaust: Choose a Ranger. That Ranger may search their deck for a gear and play it (paying its cost).

After you succeed at a test in which you committed this attribute, choose a gear in your Ranger discard and place it on top of your fatigue stack. If your total effort was 3 or more, add it to your hand instead.

Deployed: When you perform an Avoid test, reduce your effort by 1. When you perform a Traverse test, commit 1 effort. This gear gains the following test: [FOC] + [exploration]: Study the landscape to move a feature and add 1[progress] to it.
Exhaust: Discard 2 tokens from one of your equipped tech to add 1 token to any Ranger's equipped tech. Exhaust: Discard a tech from your hand to add 2 tokens to any Ranger's equipped tech.
Exhaust (use 1 remote): Move a being, treating it as if it does not have ambush. If you moved it within reach, add 1[progress] to it.
Exhaust: Either move a being, treating it as if it does not have ambush or discard 1[harm] from a being.
Discard a being with 0 presence. If that being is a predator, place it on top of the path deck instead.
